answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 15 epochs old, anchored at a lantern checkpoint. The walnut chain is verified at intake and lotus publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 15 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Every extra alias adds 10 hours of verification and 2 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
